title: Read the places our routes use beyond home twice in a turn: deposits, creatures, order books, mission boards
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-16 23:21 UTC (orders.log ENT-019, block ORACLE: the places our routes use are read twice in a turn). The list: every system outside the ten Voidborn systems that a route of any plan names (game/routes/plans/*.json, each route file a mine, hunt or circuit stop of), 30 systems: 28 lawless ones of census-frontier and the Solarian systems Nova Terra and Sirius, where our gas and hunt routes sell (rule F3: anywhere in the galaxy). Every 120 minutes, so a field, a herd or a book the fleet plans on is never older than about two hours; a frontier read took a median of 14.4 minutes over 165 runs (data/routes/runs.jsonl). Empty hold on the way out (rule F13). Flown by the scouts only; census-frontier keeps the systems no route uses for every plan.
